items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: if you would be a piano player and you play a duet with Hank Jones or Tommy Flanagan

ctx.x: Yeah but year after year, week after week, doing that unconsciously, this path starts to become so natural. At that time I didn’t realize it. It was years after I said wow, I got lucky. I mean it’s like if you would be a piano player and you play a duet with Hank Jones or Tommy Flanagan —
